query_validation.method: SPARQL result rows compared exactly with manifest-derived ground truth

queries.question: Which specimen-preparation steps produced the TEM specimen associated with the reported particle-size result?
queries.title: TEM specimen, preparation, and reported result
queries.purpose: Traverse the material chain from the TEM result and specimen to each preparation process that produced an upstream material.
queries.ground_truth_basis: TEM synthesis and specimen-preparation rows, final specimen field, and analysis target in the sanitized workbook manifest.
queries.query:
PREFIX h2kg: <https://w3id.org/h2kg/hydrogen-ontology#>
PREFIX kg: <https://w3id.org/h2kg/examples/characterization/schema#>
PREFIX case: <https://w3id.org/h2kg/examples/characterization/>
PREFIX qudt: <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/>
PREFIX prov: <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>

SELECT DISTINCT ?resultLabel ?specimenLabel ?preparationLabel ?preparedMaterialLabel
WHERE {
  GRAPH <https://w3id.org/h2kg/examples/characterization/graph/semantic/tem> {
    ?result a h2kg:DataPoint ; h2kg:fromMeasurement ?measurement ; rdfs:label ?resultLabel ; h2kg:ofProperty ?property .
    ?measurement h2kg:hasMeasurementSubject ?specimen .
    ?specimen rdfs:label ?specimenLabel .
    ?property h2kg:isCharacteristicOf ?specimen .
    ?preparation a h2kg:Manufacturing ; kg:case case:tem ; rdfs:label ?preparationLabel ; h2kg:hasOutputMaterial ?preparedMaterial .
    ?preparedMaterial rdfs:label ?preparedMaterialLabel .
    ?preparedMaterial (^h2kg:hasInputMaterial/h2kg:hasOutputMaterial)* ?specimen .
  }
}
ORDER BY ?preparationLabel ?preparedMaterialLabel

validation.comparison_method: exact row-multiset equality against expectations independently derived from the sanitized workbook manifest

queries.question: Which image dataset, analysis process, and software produced the reported TEM result?
queries.title: TEM data and analysis provenance
queries.purpose: Retrieve the dataset, software, and analysis process that produced each TEM result.
queries.ground_truth_basis: TEM analysis rows: precursor dataset, technique, software, and target output.
queries.query:
PREFIX h2kg: <https://w3id.org/h2kg/hydrogen-ontology#>
PREFIX kg: <https://w3id.org/h2kg/examples/characterization/schema#>
PREFIX case: <https://w3id.org/h2kg/examples/characterization/>
PREFIX qudt: <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/>
PREFIX prov: <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>

SELECT ?inputDataLabel ?analysisLabel ?softwareLabel ?resultLabel
WHERE {
  GRAPH <https://w3id.org/h2kg/examples/characterization/graph/semantic/tem> {
    ?result a h2kg:DataPoint ; rdfs:label ?resultLabel ; prov:wasGeneratedBy ?analysis .
    ?analysis rdfs:label ?analysisLabel ; h2kg:hasInputData ?inputData .
    ?inputData rdfs:label ?inputDataLabel .
    OPTIONAL { ?analysis h2kg:usesSoftware ?software . ?software rdfs:label ?softwareLabel . }
  }
}
ORDER BY ?resultLabel

queries.question: What specimen, instrument, and raw dataset are linked to each characterization measurement?
queries.title: Measurement subjects, instruments, and raw datasets
queries.purpose: Retrieve the core measurement context for every workbook-backed case.
queries.ground_truth_basis: The eight case definitions, final specimen fields, and method-specific measurement and instrument assignments.
queries.query:
PREFIX h2kg: <https://w3id.org/h2kg/hydrogen-ontology#>
PREFIX kg: <https://w3id.org/h2kg/examples/characterization/schema#>
PREFIX case: <https://w3id.org/h2kg/examples/characterization/>
PREFIX qudt: <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/>
PREFIX prov: <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>

SELECT ?caseKey ?measurementLabel ?specimenLabel ?instrumentLabel ?rawDatasetLabel
WHERE {
  GRAPH ?semanticGraph {
    ?case a kg:CharacterizationCase ; dcterms:identifier ?caseKey .
    ?measurement a h2kg:Measurement ; kg:case ?case ; rdfs:label ?measurementLabel ;
      h2kg:hasMeasurementSubject ?specimen ; h2kg:usesInstrument ?instrument ; h2kg:hasOutputData ?rawDataset .
    ?specimen rdfs:label ?specimenLabel .
    ?instrument rdfs:label ?instrumentLabel .
    ?rawDataset rdfs:label ?rawDatasetLabel .
  }
  FILTER(STRSTARTS(STR(?semanticGraph), "https://w3id.org/h2kg/examples/characterization/graph/semantic/"))
}
ORDER BY ?caseKey

validation.comparison_method: exact row-multiset equality against expectations independently derived from the sanitized workbook manifest

queries.question: How many workbook fields in each case were reported, missing, not applicable, unspecified, unconfirmed, unresolved, or conflicting?
queries.title: Workbook field-status summary
queries.purpose: Count reported, missing, inapplicable, unspecified, unconfirmed, unresolved-formula, and conflicting fields by case.
queries.ground_truth_basis: The explicit status assigned to every eligible field in the sanitized workbook manifest.
queries.query:
PREFIX h2kg: <https://w3id.org/h2kg/hydrogen-ontology#>
PREFIX kg: <https://w3id.org/h2kg/examples/characterization/schema#>
PREFIX case: <https://w3id.org/h2kg/examples/characterization/>
PREFIX qudt: <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/>
PREFIX prov: <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>

SELECT ?caseKey ?statusLabel (COUNT(?source) AS ?fieldCount)
WHERE {
  GRAPH ?sourceGraph { ?source a kg:SourceField ; kg:valueStatus ?status . }
  FILTER(STRSTARTS(STR(?sourceGraph), "https://w3id.org/h2kg/examples/characterization/graph/source/"))
  BIND(STRAFTER(STR(?sourceGraph), "https://w3id.org/h2kg/examples/characterization/graph/source/") AS ?caseKey)
  BIND(REPLACE(STR(?status), "^.*[#/]", "") AS ?statusLabel)
}
GROUP BY ?caseKey ?statusLabel
ORDER BY ?caseKey ?statusLabel

queries.query:
PREFIX h2kg: <https://w3id.org/h2kg/hydrogen-ontology#>
PREFIX kg: <https://w3id.org/h2kg/examples/characterization/schema#>
PREFIX case: <https://w3id.org/h2kg/examples/characterization/>

PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>

SELECT DISTINCT ?caseKey ?processLabel ?softwareLabel
WHERE {
  GRAPH ?semanticGraph {
    ?case a kg:CharacterizationCase ; dcterms:identifier ?caseKey .
    ?process a h2kg:Process ; kg:case ?case ; rdfs:label ?processLabel ; h2kg:usesSoftware ?software .
    ?software rdfs:label ?softwareLabel .
  }
  FILTER(STRSTARTS(STR(?semanticGraph), "https://w3id.org/h2kg/examples/characterization/graph/semantic/"))
}
ORDER BY ?caseKey ?processLabel ?softwareLabel

queries.question: How many measurement occurrences and result records are represented for each characterization case?
queries.title: Measurement and result counts by case
queries.purpose: Count distinct measurements and DataPoint results per case without conflating the two occurrence types.
queries.ground_truth_basis: One modeled measurement per case and the number of workbook analysis-output rows in each sanitized case record.
queries.query:
PREFIX h2kg: <https://w3id.org/h2kg/hydrogen-ontology#>
PREFIX kg: <https://w3id.org/h2kg/examples/characterization/schema#>
PREFIX case: <https://w3id.org/h2kg/examples/characterization/>
PREFIX qudt: <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/>
PREFIX prov: <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>

SELECT ?caseKey (COUNT(DISTINCT ?measurement) AS ?measurementCount) (COUNT(DISTINCT ?result) AS ?resultCount)
WHERE {
  GRAPH ?semanticGraph {
    ?case a kg:CharacterizationCase ; dcterms:identifier ?caseKey .
    ?measurement a h2kg:Measurement ; kg:case ?case .
    OPTIONAL { ?result a h2kg:DataPoint ; kg:case ?case . }
  }
  FILTER(STRSTARTS(STR(?semanticGraph), "https://w3id.org/h2kg/examples/characterization/graph/semantic/"))
}
GROUP BY ?caseKey
ORDER BY ?caseKey

queries.question: Which reported scientific results have both a defensible numeric value and an explicit QUDT unit?
queries.title: Normalized result quantities
queries.purpose: Return only result properties for which the graph asserts a complete normalized quantity-value pattern.
queries.ground_truth_basis: Analysis outputs whose AmountTarget values parse to compatible numeric values, units, and quantity kinds without a semantic conflict.
queries.query:
PREFIX h2kg: <https://w3id.org/h2kg/hydrogen-ontology#>
PREFIX kg: <https://w3id.org/h2kg/examples/characterization/schema#>
PREFIX case: <https://w3id.org/h2kg/examples/characterization/>
PREFIX qudt: <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/>
PREFIX prov: <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>

SELECT ?caseKey ?propertyLabel ?sourceCell ?rawValue ?value ?unit
WHERE {
  GRAPH ?semanticGraph {
    ?case a kg:CharacterizationCase ; dcterms:identifier ?caseKey .
    ?result a h2kg:DataPoint ; h2kg:ofProperty ?property ; kg:case ?case .
    ?property rdfs:label ?propertyLabel ; h2kg:hasMetadata ?source ; h2kg:hasQuantityValue ?qv .
    ?qv qudt:numericValue ?value ; qudt:unit ?unit .
  }
  GRAPH ?sourceGraph {
    ?source kg:fieldName "AmountTarget" ; kg:sourceCell ?sourceCell .
    OPTIONAL { ?source rdf:value ?rawValue . }
  }
  FILTER(STRSTARTS(STR(?semanticGraph), "https://w3id.org/h2kg/examples/characterization/graph/semantic/"))
  FILTER(STRSTARTS(STR(?sourceGraph), "https://w3id.org/h2kg/examples/characterization/graph/source/"))
}
ORDER BY ?caseKey ?propertyLabel

queries.query:
PREFIX h2kg: <https://w3id.org/h2kg/hydrogen-ontology#>
PREFIX kg: <https://w3id.org/h2kg/examples/characterization/schema#>
PREFIX case: <https://w3id.org/h2kg/examples/characterization/>

PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>

SELECT ?caseKey ?fieldName ?sourceCell ?statusLabel ?rawValue
WHERE {
  GRAPH ?sourceGraph {
    ?source a kg:SourceField ; kg:fieldName ?fieldName ; kg:sourceCell ?sourceCell ; kg:valueStatus ?status .
    OPTIONAL { ?source rdf:value ?rawValue . }
  }
  FILTER(STRSTARTS(STR(?sourceGraph), "https://w3id.org/h2kg/examples/characterization/graph/source/"))
  FILTER(?status != kg:reported)
  BIND(STRAFTER(STR(?sourceGraph), "https://w3id.org/h2kg/examples/characterization/graph/source/") AS ?caseKey)

}

queries.query:
PREFIX h2kg: <https://w3id.org/h2kg/hydrogen-ontology#>
PREFIX kg: <https://w3id.org/h2kg/examples/characterization/schema#>

PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>

SELECT ?caseKey ?parameterLabel ?statusLabel ?sourceCell ?rawValue
WHERE {
  GRAPH ?semanticGraph {
    ?case a kg:CharacterizationCase ; dcterms:identifier ?caseKey .
    ?measurement a h2kg:Measurement ; kg:case ?case ; h2kg:hasParameter ?parameter .
    ?parameter rdfs:label ?parameterLabel ; kg:valueStatus ?status ; h2kg:hasMetadata ?source .
    FILTER(?status != kg:reported)

  }
  GRAPH ?sourceGraph {
    ?source kg:sourceCell ?sourceCell .
    OPTIONAL { ?source rdf:value ?rawValue . }
  }
  FILTER(STRSTARTS(STR(?semanticGraph), "https://w3id.org/h2kg/examples/characterization/graph/semantic/"))
  FILTER(STRSTARTS(STR(?sourceGraph), "https://w3id.org/h2kg/examples/characterization/graph/source/"))

queries.question: Which input datasets, analysis processes, and software are linked to each reported result across all cases?
queries.title: Analysis provenance across all cases
queries.purpose: Traverse each DataPoint to its generating analysis process, input data, and source-reported software.
queries.ground_truth_basis: All analysis rows grouped by their source step and technique, including their precursor, target, and software fields.
queries.query:
PREFIX h2kg: <https://w3id.org/h2kg/hydrogen-ontology#>
PREFIX kg: <https://w3id.org/h2kg/examples/characterization/schema#>
PREFIX case: <https://w3id.org/h2kg/examples/characterization/>
PREFIX qudt: <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/>
PREFIX prov: <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>

SELECT DISTINCT ?caseKey ?analysisLabel ?inputDataLabel ?resultLabel ?softwareLabel
WHERE {
  GRAPH ?semanticGraph {
    ?case a kg:CharacterizationCase ; dcterms:identifier ?caseKey .
    ?result a h2kg:DataPoint ; rdfs:label ?resultLabel ; kg:case ?case ; prov:wasGeneratedBy ?analysis .
    ?analysis a h2kg:Process ; rdfs:label ?analysisLabel ; h2kg:hasInputData ?inputData .
    ?inputData rdfs:label ?inputDataLabel .
    OPTIONAL { ?analysis h2kg:usesSoftware ?software . ?software rdfs:label ?softwareLabel . }
  }
  FILTER(STRSTARTS(STR(?semanticGraph), "https://w3id.org/h2kg/examples/characterization/graph/semantic/"))
}
ORDER BY ?caseKey ?analysisLabel ?resultLabel ?inputDataLabel ?softwareLabel

queries.question: Which preprocessing activities transformed which input datasets into which output datasets across the eight cases?

queries.query:
PREFIX h2kg: <https://w3id.org/h2kg/hydrogen-ontology#>
PREFIX kg: <https://w3id.org/h2kg/examples/characterization/schema#>
PREFIX case: <https://w3id.org/h2kg/examples/characterization/>
PREFIX qudt: <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/>
PREFIX prov: <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>

SELECT DISTINCT ?caseKey ?processLabel ?inputDataLabel ?outputDataLabel
WHERE {
  GRAPH ?semanticGraph {
    ?case a kg:CharacterizationCase ; dcterms:identifier ?caseKey .
    ?process a h2kg:DataProcessing ; kg:case ?case ; rdfs:label ?processLabel ;
      h2kg:hasInputData ?inputData ; h2kg:hasOutputData ?outputData .
    ?inputData rdfs:label ?inputDataLabel .
    ?outputData rdfs:label ?outputDataLabel .
  }
  FILTER(STRSTARTS(STR(?semanticGraph), "https://w3id.org/h2kg/examples/characterization/graph/semantic/"))
}
ORDER BY ?caseKey ?processLabel ?inputDataLabel ?outputDataLabel
